author: reek
body: An idle connection is aged out. A client connects and sends one request, then goes silent: it never sends another request and never closes. The idle sweep bumps the connection's idle count each pass and reaps it once it reaches web-idle-max (5) passes without traffic -- the slowloris bound.

author: reek
body: After the first GET the connection has served 1 and is one connection. Four sweeps leave it alive (idle 4). The load-bearing control comes next: a second GET arrives, which resets the idle count to zero, and four more sweeps still leave it alive -- eight sweeps total, so a reap driven by a fixed sweep count rather than by inactivity would have removed it by now. The ninth sweep (the fifth since the reset) reaps it, so the connection count drops to 0.
